subject: Quick thought on Pacific Hills Dental's site and booking flow
body: Hi Dr. St. Germain and the Pacific Hills Dental team, I came across your practice while looking at cosmetic and family dental providers in Omaha, and I really appreciate your focus on customized care, especially your advanced CEREC same-day restorations and smile makeovers. While reviewing your current website, I noticed a couple of missed opportunities: the main phone number isn't easily clickable on mobile for instant calling, and the layout lacks a direct online booking widget or prominent AGD Fellow trust badges in the hero section. Because of this, I went ahead and built a modern, high-performance prototype for Pacific Hills Dental featuring a streamlined mobile layout, prominent trust markers, and an interactive services grid. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8793f2fa9b209b09-0x19ad6010347ff6c.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Made the phone number a clickable tel: link across all viewports for easier mobile calling
Added trust badges and association logos highlighting Dr. St. Germain's AGD Fellowship in the hero section
Streamlined the service grid layout for better user experience
